prompt: People who come from MkDocs write [TOC] for a table of contents, but md2conf only understands [[_TOC_]]. Please make a paragraph that consists of nothing but [TOC] produce the same table-of-contents macro as [[_TOC_]] does. Anywhere else, [TOC] must stay as it is: in the middle of a sentence, in inline code and in code blocks. Add a test.
